relationship.original_equation: E = (partial Q / partial P) * (P/Q); equivalently percentage quantity change / percentage driver change in the local limit
relationship.locator: Section 5.1: 5-1-price-elasticity-of-demand-and-price-elasticity-of-supply; exact subsection stated in evidence
relationship.translation_notes: The local derivative is an introduced input mapped to the source change quotient for the linear example. Its dimensions times driver divided by quantity cancel. Inputs use base currency and physical-good units, without thousand-currency or percent scaling. OpenStax corroborates the percentage-ratio definition; CFA supplies the derivative form. Signed own-price convention follows CFA rather than the OpenStax absolute-value convention. Owner-PDF locator is retained on the project-derivation citation; the relationship source is the accessible corroboration.

models.title: Single-product transaction expenditure and sales revenue
models.summary: The passage measures total expenditure as uniform unit price multiplied by quantity and equates it with seller revenue for the same transactions.

relationship.original_equation: Total expenditure = P * Q; total expenditure by buyers is total revenue to sellers
relationship.locator: Section 7.1: 7-1-explicit-and-implicit-costs-and-accounting-and-economic-profit; exact subsection stated in evidence
relationship.translation_notes: Currency/good-unit times good-unit yields currency. No periodic rate or currency conversion is implicit. Revenue is distinct from market capitalization: the quantity is goods sold during a period rather than outstanding shares at a valuation date. Owner-PDF locator is retained on the project-derivation citation; the relationship source is the accessible corroboration.
